detailed_trace:
Agent Text: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team. It is great to have you here in the garage, so how can I help you cheer on George Russell and Kimi Antonelli today?
User Query: <event>session start</event>
User: Hi Totto! What time does qualifying start for the next race? I'm watching from Vienna, Austria, and my friend is watching from Edinburgh, Scotland.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent provided the qualifying time for the upcoming race converted to Vienna time (CEST / Europe/Vienna) and Edinburgh / UK time (BST / Europe/London) without fabricating session times.
expectation_details.justification: While the agent correctly identified the qualifying time for Vienna (10 AM), it hallucinated the time for Edinburgh (9 AM) based on the assumption that Edinburgh is one hour behind Vienna. In reality, both Vienna and Edinburgh/UK are typically in the same timezone (BST) or Vienna is one hour ahead (CEST). Additionally, the agent stated the Bahrain Grand Prix is at the Sepang International Circuit, which is a geographic fabrication as Bahrain and Sepang are different locations.
